cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/gentrace.py <<'EOF'
import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, genbig
from ref import period
prof = genbig.big_profile()
fab = json.load(open('/tmp/bigfab2.json'))
N = fab['n']; T=fab['interval_ns']; S=fab['slice_ns']; O=fab['offset_ns']
Q=len(fab['slices']); P = period(T,S,Q)
rng = random.Random(9)
R = 1024
v = [[fab['drift_ppb'][i]]*P for i in range(N)]
for node,st,en,extra in fab['heat']:
    for p in range(st,en): v[node][p]+=extra
rates = [[rng.choice([-1,0,1])*rng.randint(0,v[i][t%P]) for i in range(N)] for t in range(R)]
cal = para.calibrate(prof)
row = cal['upper_ps'][0]
bias = [row[b] for b in range(K)] if (K:=prof['groups']) else []
sends=[]; sid=1
codes=list(range(2*len(fab['links'])))
per = {}
for _ in range(65536):
    tick = rng.randrange(R); code = rng.choice(codes)
    sends.append([sid, tick, code, 0])
    per.setdefault(tick, []).append(len(sends)-1)
    sid += 1
lost = sorted(rng.sample([s[0] for s in sends], 5000))
reboots = []
seen=set()
for _ in range(2000):
    t=rng.randrange(R+1); nd=rng.randrange(N)
    if (t,nd) in seen: continue
    seen.add((t,nd)); reboots.append([t,nd])
queries = [rng.randrange(R+1) for _ in range(120)]
tr = {'rounds':R,'rates_ppb':rates,'bias_ps':bias,'sends':sends,'lost':lost,'reboots':reboots,'queries':queries}
json.dump(tr, open('/tmp/bigtrace.json','w'))
print('ok', len(sends), len(reboots), len(queries))
EOF
python3 /tmp/gentrace.py && cat > /tmp/timereplay.py <<'EOF'

print('states', len(r['states']), 'send_status', len(r['send_status']))
print('maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
EOF
